quarterly_data.quarter: Han's CNC Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue RMB 5,772,935,488.47, up 72.68% from RMB 3,343,091,397.82; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 824,267,918.74, up 173.68%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 821,322,775.76, up 290.92%; operating cash flow RMB 180,606,678.16 (+16.53%). Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 959,848,668.68, Q2 RMB 1,421,984,485.87, Q3 RMB 1,520,984,069.00, Q4 RMB 1,870,118,264.92; quarterly net profit attributable: Q1 RMB 116,773,485.23, Q2 RMB 146,498,177.52, Q3 RMB 228,435,144.32, Q4 RMB 332,561,111.67. quarterly_data.quarter: Han's CNC Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customers (annual report): the company says its customers cover 80% of the 2024 Prismark global top-100 PCB makers, every company in the CPCA top-100 ranking and over a thousand smaller Chinese PCB makers, including Victory Giant Technology, Founder Technology, Zhen Ding, Unimicron, Dongshan Precision, AT&S, Compeq Manufacturing, Tripod Technology, Shennan Circuits, HannStar Board, Kingboard Holdings, WUS Printed Circuit, Meiko Electronics, Kinwong, CMK, Dynamic Holding and KCE, several of them leading AI-compute PCB makers. Its CCD six-axis mechanical drill with 3D back-drilling has completed processing qualification for next-generation AI-server PCBs and is in volume production at several leading high-layer-count board makers.
quarterly_data.figure: 80% of Prismark global top-100 PCB makers

quarterly_data.quarter: Han's CNC Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Market position (company claims, annual report): citing CIC consulting, it had a 6.5% global share in 2024 and calls itself the largest supplier of PCB special-purpose equipment worldwide; estimating from Prismark's forecast and its own deliveries, its mechanical drills (notably ultra-high aspect-ratio through-hole and 3D drill-and-measure drills for AI compute) had about 50% global share in 2025. It names competitors Schmoll and Mitsubishi Electric and Via Mechanics in drilling, KLA and ORC in pattern transfer and Nidec-Read in test.
quarterly_data.figure: 6.5% global share in 2024; about 50% drilling share in 2025

quarterly_data.quarter: Han's CNC Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual report): R&D spending RMB 457,541,414.31, up 71.47%, 7.93% of revenue, none capitalised; 908 R&D staff (+30.46%); 255 invention patents. Project status: AI-server board high-precision drilling equipment and pin-lamination drilling-room automation in mass production; server-PCB laser drilling for high-frequency high-speed materials in development; AI-PCB high-density test system at prototype.

quarterly_data.quarter: Han's CNC Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Advanced packaging (annual report): its new laser solutions for advanced-packaging substrates — ABF and PSPI micro-via drilling, high-precision cavity, through-glass vias (TGV) and depaneling, for FC-CSP, FC-BGA, glass, EMIB and FOPLP substrates used in smartphone SoCs, AiP and server CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs and ASICs — have passed process trials and qualified-supplier certification at several well-known domestic and overseas customers; it will continue full-process reliability verification to push batch orders. Its glass-substrate processing equipment (TGV, splitting) is at small-batch stage and its high-precision FC-CSP substrate tester (±2.0μm repeat positioning) at prototype.
quarterly_data.figure: FC-CSP tester ±2.0μm; glass-substrate tools at small-batch stage

quarterly_data.quarter: Han's CNC Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report, company outlook): 'ALL IN AI' — focus on AI-server high-layer-count HDI (HLC+HDI), 800G/1.6T optical-module and AI-smartphone substrate-like PCBs, supplying higher-precision back-drilling and stacked blind-via drilling for next-generation AI-server HDI and switch boards, extending new laser processing for SLP and preparing mSAP 3.0 technology; working with leading customers to help bring CoWoP, CPO and orthogonal backplanes to volume production; pushing advanced-packaging substrate tools toward batch orders; expanding in Southeast Asia with existing Chinese customers (a Vietnam subsidiary was set up on 12-16-2025) and setting up a resident office and R&D team in Singapore and elsewhere in Southeast Asia.
